#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <map>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

struct Modular {
    int value;

    Modular(long long v = 0) {
        if (v < 0) v %= MOD, v += MOD;
        if (v >= MOD) v %= MOD;
        value = v;
    }

    static int inverse(int a, int m = MOD) {
        int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
        while (r != 0) {
            int q = g / r;
            g %= r; swap(g, r);
            x -= q * y; swap(x, y);
        }
        return x < 0 ? x + m : x;
    }

    explicit operator int() const { return value; }

    Modular& operator+=(const Modular& other) {
        value += other.value;
        if (value >= MOD) value -= MOD;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator-=(const Modular& other) {
        value -= other.value;
        if (value < 0) value += MOD;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator*=(const Modular& other) {
        value = (uint64_t)value * other.value % MOD;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator/=(const Modular& other) {
        return *this *= Modular(inverse(other.value));
    }

    friend Modular operator+(const Modular& a, const Modular& b) { return Modular(a) += b; }
    friend Modular operator-(const Modular& a, const Modular& b) { return Modular(a) -= b; }
    friend Modular operator*(const Modular& a, const Modular& b) { return Modular(a) *= b; }
    friend Modular operator/(const Modular& a, const Modular& b) { return Modular(a) /= b; }

    Modular& operator++() {
        value = (value == MOD - 1) ? 0 : value + 1;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular& operator--() {
        value = (value == 0) ? MOD - 1 : value - 1;
        return *this;
    }

    Modular operator++(int) { Modular tmp = *this; ++(*this); return tmp; }
    Modular operator--(int) { Modular tmp = *this; --(*this); return tmp; }

    Modular operator-() const {
        return value == 0 ? 0 : MOD - value;
    }

    bool operator==(const Modular& other) const { return value == other.value; }
    bool operator!=(const Modular& other) const { return value != other.value; }

    Modular inv() const {
        return Modular(inverse(value));
    }

    Modular pow(long long p) const {
        Modular base = *this, result = 1;
        while (p > 0) {
            if (p & 1) result *= base;
            base *= base;
            p >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
};

int main() {
    int N;
    cin >> N;
    vector<vector<Modular>> prob(N, vector<Modular>(N));
    for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i)
        for (int j = 0; j < N; ++j) {
            int p;
            cin >> p;
            prob[i][j] = Modular(p) / Modular(100);
        }

    vector<vector<int>> masks_by_count(N + 1);
    vector<int> lookup(1 << N, -1);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); ++mask) {
        int c = __builtin_popcount(mask);
        lookup[mask] = (int)masks_by_count[c].size();
        masks_by_count[c].push_back(mask);
    }

    map<long long, Modular> possible;
    possible[1LL << lookup[0]] = 1;

    for (int left = 0; left < N; ++left) {
        map<long long, Modular> new_possible;
        for (int current_mask = 0; current_mask < (1 << N); ++current_mask) {
            Modular product = 1;
            for (int right = 0; right < N; ++right) {
                bool bit_set = (current_mask >> right) & 1;
                product *= bit_set ? prob[left][right] : (Modular(1) - prob[left][right]);
            }
            for (auto& p : possible) {
                long long mask_val = p.first;
                Modular prob_val = p.second;
                long long new_mask_val = 0;
                for (int m : masks_by_count[left]) {
                    if ((mask_val >> lookup[m]) & 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; ++i) {
                            if (((current_mask >> i) & 1) && ((m >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                new_mask_val |= 1LL << lookup[m | (1 << i)];
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                new_possible[new_mask_val] += prob_val * product;
            }
        }
        possible = move(new_possible);
    }

    Modular answer = 0;
    int last_mask_index = lookup[(1 << N) - 1];
    for (auto& p : possible) {
        if ((p.first >> last_mask_index) & 1) {
            answer += p.second;
        }
    }
    cout << (int)answer << "\n";
}
